title: QE trainable loops can run without fixed seed, making results non-reproducible
description: Expected: all trainable QE loops must declare an explicit fixed seed at the generation boundary, and that seed must be carried into runtime_flags.random_seed, generated config, runner setup, logs, archive metadata, and reproducibility status. Actual: experiment qe_20260520_215627_abbc completed LSTM loops with seed None, including Loop16, so same-config performance deltas could be random training variance rather than strategy signal. This fix introduces a fail-fast seed contract at MCP/template/API/executor boundaries and marks historical seedless archive payloads as audit-only rather than reproducible baselines.
reproduce_command: Inspect F:/Dev/RD-Agent-main/qe_workspace/qe_20260520_215627_abbc/Loop16/run.log and observe seed : None; before the fix a trainable loop could be scheduled and archived without runtime_flags.random_seed.
required_verification: python -m compileall backend/routers/dispatch.py backend/routers/qe_archive.py backend/routers/qe_templates.py backend/routers/quantevolver.py backend/routers/quantevolver_evolution.py backend/services/dispatch_service.py backend/services/qe_archive backend/services/qe_templates backend/services/quantevolver scripts/aistock_qe_archive_mcp_server.py scripts/aistock_qe_experiment_mcp_server.py scripts/qrun_limit.py scripts/qrun_limit_minute.py
closure_requirements: Trainable QE API, template, MCP, create, append, rerun, retry, and executor paths reject missing fixed seed before scheduling.
Normalized executable contract stores the fixed seed in runtime_flags.random_seed and removes aliases from strategy/model params where they could leak into constructors.
Qlib runner scripts seed Python, numpy, and torch when qe_runtime.random_seed is present and record deterministic flag context.
QE Archive marks historical seedless payloads as seed_policy=unset_legacy, reproducibility_level=audit_only, and verification_status=not_reproducible instead of inventing a seed.
Regression tests cover missing-seed fail-fast and seed metadata propagation paths.
GitHub issue #141 and BUG-098 registry record remain synchronized.
